_comment: The FIXTURE PRODUCT'S cell corpus. Four cells, chosen so that every self-test the oracle runs
over a product's data has something real to look at and nothing it has to pretend about:
cli|--version          a script cell, the cheapest thing busbar-stub can be asked
http|chat|ok           an http cell, one non-streaming completion through the stub
plugins.store-persist|store-fixture-a   env-gated store cells, so fixture-gate-selftest's
plugins.store-persist|store-fixture-b   case (f) has a non-empty set to cross-check against
NO `mock_control` AND NO `compare` ANYWHERE, DELIBERATELY. Both are waivers, and a fixture that
carries one is a fixture that teaches the shape of a waiver to whoever copies it next. The
guards that police them (mock-upstream.py --check-controls, diff-cells' compare policy) are
proven against the real corpus in busbar's tree; here they only have to have nothing to refuse.
The ids are deliberately unlike the ones in the tool's own fixtures/selftest-recording, so a
diff-cells run that loads THIS corpus against THAT recording owes nothing and compares nothing.

cells.why: the binary names itself; a product that cannot answer this cannot be recorded at all
one non-streaming completion, the cheapest cell that still crosses the listener
a network-backed store: recorded only when its backend URL is in the environment
a second backend, so case (f) proves the two maps agree id-for-id and not merely once
